title: Palm Grove nightclub in Corpus Christi
summary: Interviewer shows a card for the Palm Grove dance with Albert's band and Troy; Albert dates it to 1931-32.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: I found a card which said, which is, uh, about the Palm Grove nightclub of Pupers Christy Texas.

Uh, and, and, talked about Saturday, February 17th. There was no year, Jim. Looked quite old. 9.30 p.m. to 5 a.m. They had Don Albert and his pals from 9.30 p.m. to 2.30 a.m. And then the Palm Grove orchestra, 2.30 to 5 a.m. featuring Lazy Daddy at piano.
That was the same, that was in Carpers Christy Texas. Uh-huh. That had to be in, in 1931, 1932.
So Lazy Daddy got over there?
Well, yes, he traveled over the state of Texas. Uh-huh. Troy didn't stay in Dallas, that was his home. He traveled over the state of Texas.
And Lazy Daddy, uh, would play there and, and you were there and they charged only a dollar ten.
That was a lot of money then. Yeah.
